title: ALI-EVAL: A Source-Bounded Evaluation Instrument for Land-Intelligence Representations
description: ALI-EVAL v0.2 provides 16 synthetic land-intelligence tasks, 42 synthetic source records, an eight-field output schema, criterion rubric, human scoring instructions, local-case protocol, templates, and validation/aggregation scripts. It evaluates representation and evidence handling; it does not test legal accuracy or commercial product performance.
